notes.title: PatchNotes V1.2 !
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45198782/c7f2acc952dcfafe5750f4e5cbda1f828e5d9786.png[/img]

This update brings numerous improvements for an even more immersive gaming experience. We've fixed many bugs, adjusted the balance (especially character stamina), and added new features such as:

- Increased character stamina from 150 to 180.
- Fixed several anomalies that were not working correctly.

Three difficulty modes:
- Easy
- Medium
- Hardcore
to suit all playstyles.

-Increased customization with a more comprehensive options menu, including language selection and sensitivity adjustment.

-Fixed the sensitivity issue that was set to 0 at the start of the game, now it's set to 20 by default.
-Added a language change setting to the options.
-Enhanced immersion with the addition of all button sounds and animations, as well as improved visual effects.

-Added all button sounds.
-Added all button animations.
-Optimized performance for smoother gameplay.

Ready to dive into these new features? Log in now to experience the adventure!
Don't forget to give us your feedback, it's very important to us!
